text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard El's voice... And some 
cheering, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan is amazing... She always hypes up 
the crowd with her mic performance like 
that. Saying, "I'm the one who's gonna 
win!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...You really have a strong heart, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El's dedication to winning is... truly 
incredible.
